dct_description_sm: The objective of this study was to better understand the motivations and barriers that influence producers' decisions to use pain control for disbudding and dehorning. This data reflects the discussion guide that was used to guide interviews with dairy producers across Ontario.
dct_title_s: Supplementary data for: Opinions of Ontario dairy producers on the use of pain control for disbudding and dehorning calves: a qualitative study
